title: A prep sink in the island
summary: With the refrigerator at the hall end the only sink is 12.8 ft from it. A small second sink in the island makes the cook's triangle refrigerator, island sink, range: 8.1 ft at its longest and 19.1 ft in all. It adds about 3,600 USD before tax and needs a drain through the floor (A5).

rejected.value: the contractor's plan as drawn, no island sink
rejected.why: refrigerator to sink is 12.8 ft against 9 and the triangle 27.0 ft against 26

returns_if.text: when a plumber says a drain cannot reach the island (A5): then accept the long leg, or keep the refrigerator in the alcove

rejected.why: refrigerator to range is 12.0 ft against 9, and the alcove cannot become a pantry
